scope: ordinary nonfalling water current for on-foot nonflying local player; endpoints 1.11.2 and 26.2 only

facts: LocalClientPlayerEntity.tick -> ClientPlayerEntity -> PlayerEntity.tick -> Entity.tick/baseTick reaches checkWaterCollisions.

World floors minima, ceils maxima, calls isAreaLoaded with inclusive ceiled maxima, then scans each integer coordinate with upper-exclusive loops. Matching material cells pass when ceil(box.maxY) >= y+1-getHeightLoss(LEVEL).

Each LiquidBlock contributes a normalized getFlow vector; World sums them, normalizes the sum, and directly adds 0.014 of that unit direction to velocity if length>0 and hasLiquidCollision. Player gate is !abilities.flying.
LEVEL 7 has height loss 8/9 and top y+1/9; LEVEL 6 is one step fuller.
LocalPlayer.tick and Player.tick reach Entity.baseTick, which refreshes fluid interaction before later travel/movement in the same entity tick.

Fluid interaction box is bounding box deflated by 0.001. Scan minima are floor; maxima are ceil(max)-1; preflight requires full nearby chunks without loading and at least one fluid in checked sections. The detailed scan admits nonempty fluid states whose top is not below box.minY.
For a nonflying Player, isPushedByFluid is true, so current collection is enabled; inWater then applies water current at scale 0.014.

Each matching tagged nonempty cell updates tracker height to max(fluidTop-playerBoundingBox.minY, prior height), scales its normalized flow by that height when below 0.4, and increments count even for zero flow. Player impulse averages accumulated flow by 1/count; it does not normalize the final sum.

Impulse is skipped for zero count or accumulated length squared below 1.0E-5F. With horizontal prior motion below 0.003 and scaled impulse length below 0.0045000000000000005, the impulse is normalized and raised to that minimum before addDeltaMovement.
The modern LiquidBlock state cache maps legacy block-state LEVEL 1..7 to flowing FluidState amounts 7..1; its LEVEL 7 state therefore carries amount 1, and LEVEL 6 carries amount 2.
WaterFluid.Flowing reads amount from its fluid-state LEVEL property; source water is a distinct source state with amount 8.

FlowingFluid.getLegacyLevel maps non-source amount 1 to block LEVEL 7 and amount 2 to LEVEL 6. The current algorithm reads FluidState directly; block LEVEL is a legacy representation, not its current numeric input.
With no same-type fluid above, getHeight is own height amount/9, so amount 1 has top y+1/9.

A sourceward row can produce the relevant stepped states: old nonfalling liquid depth advances by 1 per horizontal step from source; modern water dropoff is 1 and horizontal spread derives amount from highest neighbor minus dropoff.

At a level-7/amount-1 cell with a level-6/amount-2 east neighbor and blocked west/north/south sides, both getFlow routines have only the east contribution. Old difference is 6-7=-1; modern is 1/9-2/9=-1/9. Both normalize to west unit flow.
Walls west/north/south plus a solid floor prevent lateral/downward escape and make the edge state persistent; no matching fluid above preserves the shallow 1/9 top.

witness.setup: Standing default-size player centered at (8.5,0,8.5), zero horizontal delta, on foot and nonflying. Solid floor at y=-1 and solid side walls enclosing the channel. Cell (8,0,8) is old water LEVEL 7 / modern flowing water FluidState amount 1 (legacy block LEVEL 7); east cell (9,0,8) is LEVEL 6 / amount 2. Continue sourceward nonfalling water east with corresponding stepped states through x=14 and a source at x=15; no matching fluid above.
witness.scan: Old bounds are x,z approximately [8.201,8.799], y [0.401,1.399], scanning x=8,z=8,y=0..1; modern box is x,z [8.201,8.799], y [0.001,1.799], also scanning x=8,z=8,y=0..1. In both, only water contributor is (8,0,8). The modern expanded preflight remains within loaded chunk (0,0) and its checked section contains fluid; old inclusive area-loaded bounds are also within that chunk.
witness.calculation: Old world sum is one west unit vector and adds 0.014 west. Modern tracker height is 1/9; one flow is scaled to 1/9, count=1, and scale 0.014 gives 0.014/9 = 0.0015555555555555555 west. The zero horizontal prior motion meets the 0.003 component gate and impulse is below the 0.0045000000000000005 minimum, so modern adds 0.0045000000000000005 west.
witness.result: Source-derived per-update impulse differs: 0.014 west versus 0.0045000000000000005 west.

caveats: The immutable comparison omits explicit west/north/south boundaries in its layout. Its single-update arithmetic holds with the stated floor and pre-fluid-update state, but adding solid side walls makes the terminal shallow state persist and removes reachability ambiguity.

26.2 FluidTagsProvider source adds WATER and FLOWING_WATER to FluidTags.WATER and FluidIds identifies their keys. This is data-provider/source evidence. The source manifests cover Java only; generated or shipped runtime tag resources were not independently checked, so water-tag membership is a runtime-resource gate for this witness.

The witness is source-level math and state reachability, not a launched runtime trajectory or parity result. Endpoints do not locate an introduction patch within 1.11.2..26.2 and do not establish full-pair tick-graph coverage or pair freeze.
